title: New in Symfony 8.2: Generics and Stricter Types in the Serializer
content:
<html><head></head><body>The Serializer component relies on the TypeInfo component to know the
type of each property it denormalizes. Symfony 8.2 makes both components
understand more of the types you already write in your PHPDoc, such as generics
and arrays of union types, and makes…</body></html>
author: Javier Eguiluz
